verdicts.reason: A reads properly left to right: can-in-circle, brand plus headline, body copy with badges, then a prominent CTA on the right. Its flaws are small: the body copy is small, the badges sit tight under the copy and the can icon is tiny. B is broken: the green circle is cut off at the left edge and split from the can, which floats on its own at the right. The SOLSTICE wordmark has dropped below the headline, the CTA has shrunk to badge size and is buried in the pill row, the body copy is illegibly small, and the right third is empty.
